release_notes: Two external fixes land in one release (thanks @lucasvaz013). Affiliate-network offer parameters now apply at runtime: the offer_params configured on a network (sub-ids, {subid}-style macros) are appended to the destination URL of every bound offer on all click routes — the tracker, both Click APIs, legacy click.php and landing-to-offer transitions — with manual parameters winning (no duplicates) and network edits taking effect on the next click without rewriting stored URLs; local offers are untouched. Connecting a Telegram bot no longer reports 'Connection error' for a valid token: the panel and the bot share one transport in core/telegram_api.php instead of dying on 'Cannot redeclare orbitraTelegramApi()' while the command menu registers, and completed single-row SQLite cursors are released before the request waits on Telegram, removing stale-WAL db_locked failures under concurrent clicks or cron commits. Three new regression suites cover both fixes, including a 248-check HTTP suite.
